title: August and the Safehouse
author: Felix Delacroix
blurb: Ada Underhill, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
